spell.desc.brand_recall: Teleport all placed brands to yourself, activating them once, and increasing their attachment range by 5 blocks
spell.desc.armageddon_brand: Place a brand that periodically calls down a meteor dealing [calc:armageddon_brand_damage] §c☀ Fire§7 Damage in an area.
spell.desc.penance_brand: Place a brand that rapidly gains energy before exploding, dealing [calc:penance_brand_explosion] §6☀ Physical§7 Damage in an area and destroying the brand.
spell.desc.wintertide_brand: Place a brand that repeatedly releases a Frost Nova dealing [calc:wintertide_brand_damage] §b☀ Cold§7 Damage in an area.
mmorpg.stat_desc.health_reservation: Reserves a percentage of maximum Health while this skill remains active.
mmorpg.stat.mana_reservation: Reserves [VAL1]% Mana (or Blood with Blood Mage)
mmorpg.stat_desc.mana_reservation: Reserves a percentage of maximum Mana while this skill remains active. This instead reserves Blood while Blood Mage is active.
mmorpg.stat_desc.energy_reservation: Reserves a percentage of maximum Energy while this skill remains active.
mmorpg.stat_desc.reservation_efficiency: Reduces the percentage of Health, Mana, Energy, or Blood reserved.
spell.desc.herald_of_ice: Toggle a buff that adds flat Cold Damage to all hits. Inflicting Freeze has a 50% chance to immediately explode the target for [calc:herald_of_ice_explosion] §b☀ Cold§7 Damage.
spell.desc.herald_of_ash: Toggle a buff that adds flat Fire Damage to all hits. Inflicting Burn has a 50% chance to immediately explode the target for [calc:herald_of_ash_explosion] §c☀ Fire§7 Damage.
spell.desc.herald_of_thunder: Toggle a buff that adds flat Lightning Damage to all hits. Applying Electrify grants a 6-second storm that calls lightning onto one enemy each second, dealing [calc:herald_of_thunder_strike] §e☀ Lightning§7 Damage.
spell.desc.blade_vortex: Cast to add an ethereal blade for 4 seconds, up to 10 blades. At maximum stacks, each hit deals [calc:blade_vortex_10] §6☀ Physical§7 Damage. Hits count as Basic Attacks.
spell.desc.winter_orb: Cast to gain a stack of Winter Orb, which periodically fires projectiles at nearby enemies dealing [calc:winter_orb] §b☀ Cold§7 Damage. +30% increased duration and fire rate per stack.
spell.desc.ball_lightning: Fire a slow-moving orb that rapidly deals [calc:ball_lightning_bolt] §e☀ Lightning§7 Damage to nearby enemies. Lightning Warp detonates the Ball Lightning projectile you aim near for [calc:ball_lightning_explosion] §e☀ Lightning§7 Damage.
spell.desc.storm_brand: Place a brand that activates every 0.5 seconds, dealing [calc:storm_brand_damage] §e☀ Lightning§7 Damage to the branded enemy, chaining to up to two additional enemies.
spell.desc.archmage_brand: Place a brand that activates once per second, dealing [calc:archmage_brand_nova] §b☀ Cold§7 Damage, [calc:archmage_brand_nova] §c☀ Fire§7 Damage, and [calc:archmage_brand_nova] §e☀ Lightning§7 Damage in an area.
spell.desc.spark: Fire three electric projectiles with a wide spread. Each projectile deals [calc:spark] §e☀ Lightning§7 Damage.
spell.desc.vortex: Release a Cold nova for [calc:vortex_nova] §b❄ Cold§7 Damage, and leave behind a vortex for 5 seconds that deals [calc:vortex_field] §b❄ Cold§7 Damage four times per second.
spell.desc.frostblink: Teleport forward, dealing [calc:frostblink] §b☀ Cold§7 Damage at the start and end of the teleport.
spell.desc.creeping_frost: Launch a frozen projectile that explodes for [calc:creeping_frost_impact] §b❄ Cold§7 Damage and leaves behind a frost field for 5 seconds that tracks enemies, dealing [calc:creeping_frost_field] §b❄ Cold§7 Damage per second in an area.
spell.desc.lightning_tendrils: Fire a wide spread of lightning. Each bolt deals [calc:lightning_tendrils] §e☀ Lightning§7 Damage.
mmorpg.stat.contagion_spread_on_kill: Enemies affected by Contagion spread it on kill, also spreading Essence Drain if present
spell.desc.contagion: Afflict enemies in an area with a vile contagion for [calc:contagion_dot] §5☀ Chaos§7 Damage per second.
spell.desc.essence_drain: Fires a projectile that deals [calc:essence_drain_dot] §5☀ Chaos§7 Damage per second to the struck target. Recover 0.5% of the damage dealt as §c❤ Health Regen§7.

mmorpg.stat_desc.virulence_on_poison: Successful Poison hits grant one Virulence stack while Herald of Agony is active.

mmorpg.stat_desc.agony_crawler_damage: Each Virulence stack grants the Agony Crawler 5% More Damage, up to 200% at 40 stacks.
spell.desc.herald_of_agony: Toggle a buff granting 20% chance to Poison and 10% More Poison Damage. Inflicting Poison grants Virulence (maximum 40) and summons an Agony Crawler. Each stack ofVirulence grants the crawler 5% More Damage. Virulence decays faster at high stacks. The Crawler fires a homing projectile and melee nova each deal [calc:agony_crawler_attack] §6☀ Physical§7 Damage.
mmorpg.stat.sentinel_of_purity_on_hit: Chance to Summon a Sentinel of Purity on Hit
mmorpg.stat_desc.sentinel_of_purity_on_h: 5% chance on hit to summon a Sentinel of Purity.
spell.desc.herald_of_purity: Toggle a buff granting More Physical Damage. Hits have a 5% chance to summon a Sentinel of Purity at the struck enemy. Up to four Sentinels can be active. Their basic attacks deal [calc:sentinel_of_purity_basic] §6☀ Physical§7 Damage, and their melee novas deal [calc:sentinel_of_purity_aoe] §6☀ Physical§7 Damage every 1.2 seconds.
mmorpg.stat.learn_herald_of_the_hive: Level to Herald of the Hive
mmorpg.stat.learn.herald_of_the_hive: Level to Herald of the Hive
mmorpg.stat_desc.otherworldly_pressure_o: Inflicting any ailment grants one Otherworldly Pressure while Herald of the Hive is active.
spell.desc.herald_of_the_hive: Grants 3% More Damage for each Herald affecting you, including this Herald. While active, releases a dark-purple pulse every 2.1 seconds, dealing [calc:herald_of_the_hive_pulse] §6☀ Physical§7, [calc:herald_of_the_hive_pulse] §c☀ Fire§7, [calc:herald_of_the_hive_pulse] §b☀ Cold§7, [calc:herald_of_the_hive_pulse] §e☀ Lightning§7, and [calc:herald_of_the_hive_pulse] §5☀ Chaos§7 Damage. Inflicting an ailment grants Otherworldly Pressure, increasing the rate of pulses by 10% per stack. Pressure decays faster at higher stacks.
